The board-wide minimum values that DRC checks against.

Net Classes override some of them per Net. Later per-Layer or per-area rules (and a rule
query language) are meant to be new object kinds that override these values in a
scope, so this set stays the board-wide fallback.

clearance.description: Minimum clearance between copper of different Nets.

edge_clearance.description: Minimum clearance from copper to the Board Outline and Board Cutouts.

commands.description: Creates a Project called `name` in the folder `<path>/<name>/`, writes it to disk and opens it: a first Schematic Sheet titled "Sheet 1", a PCB Document whose rules are seeded from `fab_preset` (default Generic), optionally a rectangular Board Outline (`board`), and one Output Job named after the preset. A folder that exists and is not empty is refused.

BoardParam.description: A rectangular Board Outline with its lower left corner at the origin.

corner_radius.description: Rounds each corner with this radius; left out for sharp corners.

Length.description: A length: integer nanometres, or a number and a unit (nm, um, mm, mil or in) such as "1.27mm", "10mil" or "0.5in".

oneOf.description: Nanometres.
A number and a unit: nm, um, mm, mil or in.

board.description: A rectangular Board Outline to start with; left out to draw it later.

fab_preset.description:
The Fab Preset that seeds the board's rules and names the first Output Job: a
shipped preset (Generic, JLCPCB, PCBWay) or one of the user's `.redafab` presets.
Defaults to Generic.

name.description: The Project name: its folder name and the stem of its `.reda` file.

path.description: The folder in which the Project's own folder `<path>/<name>/` is created.

DocumentEntry.description: One Document in the Project's Document list, stored in `<name>.reda`.

name.description: The file stem; the Document's file is `<name>.<extension>` in the Project folder.

title.description: What the user typed as the Document's title, such as "Sheet 1".

DocumentKind.description: What kind of Document an entry is.

commands.title: New Project

commands.description: Opens the Project at `path`: its `.reda` file or its folder. Any Project already open is closed without saving. A missing PCB Document file is reported in `missing` and left out, which dirties the Project file.

path.description: The `.reda` file, or the Project folder that holds `<folder name>.reda`.

DocumentEntry.description: One Document in the Project's Document list, stored in `<name>.reda`.

name.description: The file stem; the Document's file is `<name>.<extension>` in the Project folder.

title.description: What the user typed as the Document's title, such as "Sheet 1".

DocumentKind.description: What kind of Document an entry is.

commands.title: Open Project

commands.description: Summarises the open Project: its name and UUID, and each Document in Project order with its kind, title and how many objects of each type it holds.

params.description: Params for a Command that takes none: accepts `{}` (or `null`) and refuses any field.
params.title: NoParams

DocumentKind.description: What kind of Document an entry is.

objects.description: How many objects of each type the Document holds. Types with none are left out.

commands.title: Project Overview

commands.description: Writes the Project file and every Document to the Project folder, each through a temp file and a rename. With `document`, writes only that Document's file, or only the Project file for `"project"`.

DocumentRef.description: One file of the Project: "project" for the Project file, or a Document's UUID.

document.description:
Saves only this file: a Document's UUID, or `"project"` for the Project file.
Omitted, every file is saved (Save All).

written.description: Every file written, relative to the Project folder.
